editorial: If you enjoy a good revenge story with a smart twist, this one will grab you fast. The movie follows Clyde Shelton, a regular guy whose family is murdered. When the justice system lets one killer walk free through a plea deal, Clyde decides to take matters into his own hands. He goes after not just the killer, but the district attorney and everyone involved in the deal. The vibe is tense and dark, with a cat-and-mouse feel that keeps you guessing. Gerard Butler plays Clyde with a calm, scary intensity, while Jamie Foxx brings energy as the district attorney trying to stop him. The pacing is quick, and the action scenes are sharp and exciting. On the downside, some plot points feel a bit over the top, and the story gets pretty wild near the end. Still, it is a fun, gripping ride. If you like thrillers that make you think about justice and revenge, you will have a blast. Stream it in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video, rent it on Apple TV, or grab the 4K Blu-ray for the best picture.
endingExplained: In the final act, you learn Clyde has been using tunnels and hidden rooms to carry out his attacks from inside prison. He kills the district attorney's colleague and threatens more chaos. The big twist is that Clyde planned everything from the start, even his own arrest. In the end, the district attorney finds Clyde's secret tunnel, plants a bomb in his cell, and blows him up before he can finish his plan. The movie closes with the district attorney walking away, having beaten Clyde at his own game.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves thrillers about justice and revenge.
